attributes.morphology: grains with different grain sizes and dislocation density distributions

evidence.quote: After annealing at 700 °C, the microstructure of the HEA is a heterogeneous structure composed of grains with different grain sizes and dislocation density distributions
dislocation slip in most recrystallized grains is greatly restricted
the dislocation source is largely activated at the recrystallized grain boundaries
The deformation twins were mainly distributed in coarse grains that were not recrystallized
When the annealing temperature was 900 °C, a completely recrystallized structure was formed and the grain size increased simultaneously
the newly proliferated dislocations inside the non-recrystallized grains interact with the original dislocations
the alloy contains a small amount of annealing twins and stacking faults
